verdict.rationale: 2FAS is an authenticator and password manager, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence shows one exists. Its agent-facing plumbing (llms.txt, .md mirrors, machine-readable pricing) is documentation only, and the llms.txt itself states 'Public API: None', with no agent-callable endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
